name: iter_final3_normal
description: UNIFIED PAPER SETTING 1 (STANDARD): the three mix policies at the companion operating point with the selection kernel narrowed to sigma 0.3, which concentrates the round-1 repair enough to be visible in the figures (at sigma 0.5 the guided round-1 selection barely differs from random) and makes the later-round misdirected focus costlier. All settings share alpha0 0.5, sigma 0.3, n_select 100, K=8; this one keeps the default initial model (12 epochs, 100 points) and full pool. 15 seeds.
